meta.description: Jade & Ember is a fictional modern Chinese kitchen: a cinematic restaurant website concept by Simplified Tech Solutions. Sample menu, hours and address.

disclosure.bar: Fictional restaurant — a concept design by Simplified Tech Solutions. Menu, prices, address and hours are samples.
disclosure.footer: Jade & Ember is a fictional restaurant created by Simplified Tech Solutions as a website design concept. It does not exist. All menu items, prices, the address, the phone number and the opening hours are invented samples. Food imagery is AI-generated concept art and does not depict real dishes served by any restaurant.

headline: The breath
of the wok.
hero.text: Carbon steel, a flame that roars, and a kitchen that cooks to the second. Open Tuesday to Sunday.
hero.caption: Wok-seared beef, broccoli, red chili

image.alt: A carbon steel wok on a roaring gas flame, tossing sliced beef, broccoli and red chili while steam rises into a dark kitchen.

intro.label: Wok hei
intro.body: Wok hei is the smoky, singed sweetness that only comes from food moving fast over a very hot flame. We cook every wok dish to order, in small batches, so the heat stays in the dish and not in the waiting.

story.label: Story
story.pull: A small kitchen, one very hot wok.
paragraphs: Jade & Ember began as an idea about a single flame: what if a dining room felt like standing beside a wok at full heat, without the noise or the smoke?

The room is charcoal and slate, lit low, with jade-glazed bowls on the pass. The kitchen cooks Cantonese and Sichuan home dishes with a lighter hand, and the menu stays short so every dish gets its turn at the fire.
story.caption: The wok burner, with the flame at full height.

image.alt: Close view of an orange gas flame licking the underside of a blackened carbon steel wok.
